scope: Exposure and bloom configuration, pure exposure calculations, histogram and adaptation HLSL, production-included math regressions
reviewed: Legacy numeric exposure remains required and preserves its multiplier. Optional objects default field-by-field while rejecting unknown keys, wrong types, nonfinite data and invalid relationships.
Manual multiplier is exp2(compensationEV - manualEV100) / 1.2. Automatic target uses logarithmic gray calibration, compensation and configured EV limits.
Adaptation uses log exposure, separate bright/dark half-lives, nonnegative time bounded to 0.1 seconds, and monotonic endpoint clipping.

CPU histogram accumulates all uint32 bins in uint64 and performs fractional-rank clipping before log-luminance averaging. GPU excludes invalid pixels, records invalid/finite counts and applies pre-exposure logarithmically.
HLSL production source is directly included by scalar/vector CPU adapters. Histogram stage uses uniform group synchronization for edge groups, with explicit caller-clear/UAV-barrier contract.

corrected_finding.finding: Adjacent legal percentiles can round to the same rank after multiplication by the histogram count. The initial implementation rejected this legal interval.
corrected_finding.resolution: CPU and GPU reducers choose the containing nonempty bucket for a collapsed numerical rank interval. The exact CPU case and float GPU collapse case are covered by regression tests.

boundary: GPU shader execution and runtime binding are separate integration evidence. This record covers source review and independently rerun MSVC and clang-cl tests.
